svg.title: This library replays the Windows synth sample for sample
svg.desc: A recording of the Windows synth (Windows Server 2022) and this library replaying the same events and render calls: the waveforms are the same and the largest difference over the whole 146 s song is 0.
svg.text: This library replays the Windows synth sample for sample
The Windows synth recorded on Windows Server 2022, and this library given the same events and render calls.
largest |difference| in each 0.5 s, the whole 146 s song
excerpt: 20 ms from 130.32 s into the song; difference in 16-bit sample steps
